print(df.dtypes)

print(df.isnull().sum())

# ============================================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("TOP 10 HOTTEST CITIES — AVERAGE TEMPERATURE (deg C)")
print("=" * 80)
for rank, (city, temp) in enumerate(cities_avg.items(), 1):
